genomes.name: Calm Rising Trend
genomes.thesis: Above the 50-day, 20-day volatility under 22%, 20-day mean rising; out on volatility over 30%, a break of the 50-day or a 2% down day.
genomes.rationale: calm_trend v2, Claude: strict structure after v1 bred itself into buy-and-hold

entry_rules.when: close > sma50 and vol20 < 0.22 and sma20_slope > 0

genomes.name: Low-Range EMA Trend
genomes.thesis: EMA 12 over 26 above the 50-day with daily range under 1.6%; out when the range widens past 2% or the EMAs cross down.

entry_rules.when: ema12 > ema26 and close > sma50 and atr_pct < 0.016

genomes.name: Contracting Volatility Over the 50
genomes.thesis: Above the 20-day and the 50-day while short-term volatility is below long-term; out when it expands 40%.

entry_rules.when: close > sma20 and dist_sma50 > 0 and vol_ratio_20_60 < 1.1

genomes.name: Bull Market, Crash-Day Exit
genomes.thesis: Above the 200-day in a market under 30% volatility; step out after a 1.5% down day.

entry_rules.when: close > sma200 and ret1 > -0.015 and vol20 < 0.3

genomes.name: Quiet MACD Trend
genomes.thesis: MACD histogram positive above the 50-day in a quiet market.

entry_rules.when: macd_hist > 0 and close > sma50 and vol20 < 0.25

genomes.name: Calm Trend, Managed
genomes.thesis: The calm trend with the managed exits that worked in the trend-plus-dip island.
